method: Exploratory current-constituent historical screen; survivorship and selection bias. Unadjusted Yahoo OHLC; no dividends or taxes. 0.2% friction each side, next-session open execution, TP using daily high (optimistic intraday fill), 5 simultaneous holdings maximum, new allocation <=20% of equity, no forced sale after appreciation, no fractional shares. No benchmark or out-of-sample validation.
